analyticalMisses.summary: Five F5 positions (SF/CLE NO, TOR/TB YES, ATL/CWS YES, ATH/KC NO, WSH/TEX YES) combined for $82 of the $116 straight+parlay slate exposure (70.7%) and went 0-5. Protected-F5-style NO contracts (SF/CLE, ATH/KC) only protect against a tie, not a genuine wrong-side handicap -- both lost outright.

analyticalWins.summary: Kansas City 5+ runs won (+7.20) in a game the Athletics F5/4+ theses otherwise lost -- an independent team-total expression on the same game held up despite the correlated F5 cluster failing.

gameLevelConcentration.note: Three separate wagers on one game (F5 NO-KC, ATH 4+, KC 5+): F5 leg lost, ATH 4+ lost, KC 5+ won. Same-game concentration risk.

performanceByMarketFamily.note: All five F5 positions lost -- 70.7% of the slate's straight-position exposure concentrated in one market family.

processErrors.summary: Primary failure was portfolio construction and F5-family concentration, not any single bad handicap. Protected F5 protects only tie risk, not a wrong-side outcome -- it should not be treated as inherently safe or as a default expression family. One correlated market-family cluster was able to erase the day.

proposedInvestigations.summary: Compare F5 team YES / F5 Tie YES / F5 protected NO against full-game ML and team-total ladders before treating any F5 expression as a default; require a fee-adjusted positive-EV check with a conservative uncertainty haircut before qualifying a protected-F5-style position.

blockedWagers.detail: 7-leg combo/parlay (rounded risk $2, paid $0, max payout $93.45, legs: STL ML W, STL 5+ W, SF ML L, ATH ML L, ATH 4+ L, TB F5 L, CWS F5 L). The canonical bet schema (scripts/edgelab/import_bet_batch.py / lib.edgelab.bets) represents one wager as exactly one marketTicker+side+entryPrice against one archived market; it has no representation for a single Kalshi multi-leg combo position spanning 7 distinct tickers/games with one combined stake and payout. Recording it as a single bet against any one leg's ticker would misattribute the other six legs' economics to that ticker; splitting it into 7 fabricated independent bet rows with invented per-leg prices was refused (no per-leg entry price was ever supplied). Excluded from the canonical ledger and from canonicalTotals; the day's combo-inclusive P/L of -$84.80 (vs -$82.80 canonical/straight-only) differs from canonicalTotals by exactly this $2 risk / $0 return / -$2.00 net gap.
